sources.title: Anthropic: Pricing, model pricing table
sources.quote: | Model | Base input tokens | 5m cache writes | 1h cache writes | Cache hits and refreshes | Output tokens |

sources.title: Anthropic: Pricing, prompt caching multipliers (cache writes)
sources.quote: 5-minute cache write | 1.25x base input price | Cache valid for 5 minutes; 1-hour cache write | 2x base input price | Cache valid for 1 hour

sources.title: Anthropic: Pricing, prompt caching multipliers (cache reads)
sources.quote: Cache read (hit) | 0.1x base input price (0.025x on Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1; 0.05x on Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5)

sources.title: Anthropic: Pricing, long context pricing
sources.quote: Claude Haiku 5.5 is priced by prompt length: a request whose prompt is over 100,000 tokens pays higher prices. A request’s prompt length counts all of its input tokens, including cache reads and cache writes.

sources.title: Anthropic: Pricing, fast mode pricing
sources.quote: | Claude Opus 5.5 | $8 USD / MTok | $40 USD / MTok | ... | Claude Opus 5 / Claude Opus 4.8 | $10 USD / MTok | $50 USD / MTok |

sources.title: Anthropic: Pricing, fast mode pricing (stacking)
sources.quote: Prompt caching multipliers apply on top of fast mode pricing.

sources.title: Claude Platform release notes, October 7, 2026 (Sonnet 5.5 cache reads)
sources.quote: We’ve lowered the price of prompt cache reads on Claude Sonnet 5.5 from $0.20 USD to $0.10 USD per million tokens: 0.05x the base input price instead of 0.1x. Cache writes and all other prices are unchanged.

sources.title: Anthropic: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5 (October 7, 2026)
sources.quote: Cache reads $0.01 / $0.05 ... Cache writes $0.125 / $0.625 ... Input tokens $0.10 / $0.50 ... Output tokens $0.50 / $2.50 (Haiku 5.5 prompts up to / over 100k)

sources.title: Anthropic: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5 (October 7, 2026), Sonnet 5.5 cache reads
sources.quote: First, starting today, we’re lowering the price of cache reads on Claude Sonnet 5.5. Cache reads now cost 50% less: $0.10 per million tokens rather than $0.20.

sources.title: Anthropic: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5.5 (September 28, 2026)
sources.quote: Sonnet 5.5 is priced the same as Sonnet 5 at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens

sources.title: Anthropic: Introducing Claude Opus 5.5 (September 22, 2026)
sources.quote: Input and output tokens are $4 and $20 per million, 20% less than Opus 5. Cache reads (which make up the majority of agentic and coding work costs) are $0.20 per million tokens, 60% less than Opus 5.

sources.title: Anthropic: Introducing Claude Opus 5.5 (September 22, 2026), fast mode
sources.quote: Fast mode for Opus 5.5 is also available in Claude Code and the Claude Platform with up to 2.5x speed. It costs $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens.

sources.title: Claude Platform release notes, September 1, 2026 (Fable 5.1, Mythos 5.1)
sources.quote: Prompt cache reads on Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 cost $0.25 USD per million tokens: 0.025x the base input price, compared with 0.1x on other models. Cache writes are unchanged.

sources.title: Claude Platform release notes, September 1, 2026 (Fable 5.1 price)
sources.quote: at $10 / $50 USD per MTok, the same as Claude Fable 5, with cache reads cut to $0.25 USD per MTok

sources.title: Claude Platform release notes, August 10, 2026 (Sonnet 5)
sources.quote: The introductory pricing for Claude Sonnet 5 ($2 / $10 USD per MTok) is now the standard price: the previously scheduled increase to $3 / $15 USD per MTok on September 1, 2026, will not occur.

sources.title: Claude Platform release notes, July 24, 2026 (Opus 5)
sources.quote: at $5 / $25 USD per MTok, the same pricing as Claude Opus 4.8

sources.title: Claude Platform release notes, April 16, 2026 (Opus 4.7)
sources.quote: We’ve launched Claude Opus 4.7, our most capable model for complex reasoning and agentic coding, at the same $5 / $25 USD per MTok pricing as Opus 4.6.

sources.title: Anthropic: Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5 (June 9, 2026)
sources.quote: Pricing for both models is $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens.

sources.title: Anthropic: Introducing Claude Sonnet 4.6 (February 17, 2026)
sources.quote: Pricing remains the same as Sonnet 4.5, starting at $3/$15 per million tokens.

sources.title: Anthropic: Introducing Claude Sonnet 4.5 (September 29, 2025)
sources.quote: Pricing remains the same as Claude Sonnet 4, at $3/$15 per million tokens.

sources.title: Anthropic: Introducing Claude Haiku 4.5 (October 15, 2025)
sources.quote: Pricing is now $1/$5 per million input and output tokens.

sources.title: Anthropic: Introducing Claude Opus 4.5 (November 24, 2025)
sources.quote: Pricing is now $5/$25 per million tokens
